title: Nimitz Tic Tac acceleration and power estimates
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of Nimitz Tic Tac acceleration and power estimates, about 2004 at Off Southern California, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in the case of the Nimtt, we estimate the acceleration of the Tic Tac falling from 28,000 feet to sea level at 7.5 seconds or so, 78 seconds.

plain: In 2004, off Southern California, Navy pilots from the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz say they saw the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. A researcher named Kevin Knuth told podcast host Jesse Michels that his group estimated how fast the object accelerated when it reportedly dropped from 28,000 feet to sea level in a matter of seconds. If the figures hold, that would be a speed and power far beyond any known aircraft.
